articles.headline: NFL Week 9 uniforms: Eagles rock 'Kelly Green,' Chargers don 'Super Chargers'
articles.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 9, led by throwbacks from the Eagles.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第9週のユニフォーム：イーグルスが「ケリーグリーン」を、チャージャーズが「スーパーチャージャーズ」を着用
articles.descriptionJa: イーグルスのリバイバルユニフォームをはじめ、NFL各チームが第9週に着用するユニフォームを紹介する。
articles.body:
While Week 8 meant the debut of two "Rivalries" jerseys, another alternate look returns to the field in Week 9, and a popular throwback comes back. 

The Los Angeles Chargers are wearing their "Super Chargers" all-navy threads against the Houston Texans. Unveiled in 2025, the Chargers deemed the navy uniforms "a true modern throwback." It's a nod to threads worn in the 1990s and early 2000s, which coincided with a Super Bowl XXIX appearance and four AFC West titles. The navy jersey includes white modern numbers with an old-school outline and gold trim. The navy pants boast a bolt on the side, while a bolt also runs on the shoulders and helmet. "Super Chargers" is stitched in white on the neckline. 

In a trend that's becoming more common around the league, the New York Giants and Philadelphia Eagles offer a matchup of throwback uniforms. The Eagles are rocking their "Kelly Green" threads, while it's a "Vintage White" look for the Giants. "Thursday Night Football" between the Denver Broncos and Seattle Seahawks in Week 6 also brought a throwback threads matchup. Philadelphia brought back the iconic Kelly Green combination in 2023, while New York's look returned in 2025 after a one-year hiatus. 

Alternates are still represented well throughout the week, though.

The Baltimore Ravens are wearing their "Purple Rising" combination on "Thursday Night Football" against the Jacksonville Jaguars. Baltimore unveiled the look in the offseason as part of their wardrobe overhaul. It includes a new "Purple Rising" helmet, first introduced in 2024 with the alternate purple jersey. The primary logo appears on the metallic purple lid instead of the front-facing Ravens one. Different from the previous all-purple combination is a new "midnight purple" color, which is meant to emulate the iridescence of a raven's feather, and "Purple Rising" running on the inside collar.

The New Orleans Saints are going gold against the Cleveland Browns. And it's another navy look for the Dallas Cowboys against the Indianapolis Colts, who are doing a rare home white out.

articles.headline: Hall of Famer Jack Ham hospitalized, in stable condition after medical emergency
articles.description: Hall of Fame linebacker and Penn State radio analyst Jack Ham experienced a medical emergency Saturday in Seattle and was in stable condition.
articles.headlineJa: 殿堂入りのジャック・ハム、急病で入院も容体は安定
articles.descriptionJa: 殿堂入りのラインバッカーであり、ペンシルベニア州立大学のラジオアナリストを務めるジャック・ハムが土曜日にシアトルで急病に見舞われたが、現在は容体は安定している。
articles.body:
Hall of Fame linebacker and Penn State radio analyst Jack Ham was in stable condition after experiencing a medical emergency Saturday in Seattle, Nittany Lions coach Matt Campbell said after his team's 28-25 win over Washington.

Ham, 77, was transported to University of Washington Medical Center, where he was being treated.

Campbell called it a "gut-wrenching day for Penn State football," and said play-by-play announcer Steve Jones, Ham's longtime radio broadcast partner, made a "heroic effort" in assisting Ham.

"If it's not for Steve, what he did, I don't know if we have as good a news as we do right now," said Campbell, who also praised Washington athletic director Pat Chun and the Huskies' staff for helping Ham. 

Ham has been the radio analyst for his alma mater since 2000. 

Ham was a six-time All-Pro selection with the Pittsburgh Steelers, with whom he won four Super Bowl championships and made eight Pro Bowl appearances. He earned All-America honors at Penn State in 1970.

He entered the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 1988 and the College Football Hall of Fame two years later.

The Johnstown, Pennsylvania, native was named to the NFL's 1970s All-Decade Team and all-time teams for both the NFL and Steelers, who have Ham in their hall of honor.

articles.headline: Nuggets beat the Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City behind Nikola Jokic's 19 points
articles.description: — Nikola Jokic scored 10 of his 19 points in the first quarter and the Denver Nuggets beat the Indiana Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City.
articles.headlineJa: ナゲッツ、ニコラ・ヨキッチの19得点でペイサーズに114-102で勝利（メキシコシティ戦）
articles.descriptionJa: ニコラ・ヨキッチが第1クォーターに19得点中10得点を挙げ、デンバー・ナゲッツがメキシコシティでインディアナ・ペイサーズに114-102で勝利した。
articles.body:
MEXICO CITY -- — Nikola Jokic scored 10 of his 19 points in the first quarter and the Denver Nuggets beat the Indiana Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City.


              Jokic also grabbed 13 rebounds and dished out eight assists, while Cameron Johnson added 18 points and Jamal Murray finished with 16 for the Nuggets, who have won four of their last five games.


              “I just try to play the game the right way, hopefully we can win more games; to win is the most important thing, I do not think about stats,” Jokic said.


              Pascal Siakam scored 23 points and Larry Nance Jr. added 15 off the bench for the Pacers, who were the home team in the NBA’s 35th game played south of the border. Indiana has lost five of its last six games.


              The Pacers played without All-Star guard Tyrese Haliburton, who missed the trip due to a hamstring strain.


              Denver capitalized on a four-minute Indiana scoring drought in the second quarter with a 15-0 run. Murray's jumper extended the Nuggets’ lead to 64-37 — their largest of the game — with less than a minute remaining in the first half.


              “It was tough environment, we are not used to this, the altitude and everything is hard to get going,” Siakam said. “Our force and energy was better in the second half, but it was not enough.”


              The Pacers responded in the third quarter, pulling closer following back-to-back 3-pointers from Aaron Nesmith that cut the score to 79-67. A layup by Quenton Jackson with 1:16 left in the quarter further trimmed Denver’s lead to 10.


              Jarace Walker hit a 3-pointer that brought Indiana within 102-95 with 7:26 left to play, but the Nuggets answered with six straight points to restore a double-digit lead and secure the win.


              The game marked the 35th NBA appearance in the country since the league first brought exhibition games to Mexico in 1992.


              No country outside the United States and Canada has hosted more.


              Of those 34 previous matchups, 15 were regular-season games, and the last 12 — including Saturday’s tilt between Indiana and Denver — sold out.


              “The energy was awesome, I got to admit that there is an atmosphere to this building, when we got out on the court you could feel the juice, and the energy,” said Nuggets coach David Adelman. “The NBA is global and it belongs here too.”


              Up next
              Nuggets: At Houston on Monday night.


              Pacers: At Dallas on Monday night.


              ------


              
                See AP’s full NBA coverage here

articles.headline: Mourinho on Real Madrid's latest win: Happy dressing room -- with horrible music
articles.description: José Mourinho described a happy Real Madrid dressing room after an eighth straight win, before joking that his players had celebrated with "horrible music."
articles.headlineJa: ムリーニョ、レアル・マドリードの直近の勝利について：ロッカールームは快調だが、流れている音楽はひどい
articles.descriptionJa: ジョゼ・ムリーニョは8連勝後のレアル・マドリードのロッカールームが幸せな雰囲気に包まれていると語り、選手たちが「ひどい音楽」で祝っていたと冗談を飛ばした。
articles.body:
José Mourinho described a happy Real Madrid dressing room after the team recorded an eight-straight victory on Saturday, before joking that his players had celebrated with "horrible music."

After Federico Valverde opened the scoring, Arda Güler notched his third goal in five matches before adding a late assist for Kylian Mbappé as Madrid cruised to a 3-0 win at Valencia.

After a rocky start upon Mourinho's return for a second spell in charge this season, Madrid are now level on points with Barcelona at the top of LaLiga ahead of the champions' clash at Atlético Madrid on Sunday.

Madrid have won all eight games since a loss at Atlético on Sept. 20.

"What makes me happy is that we've never had chaos; we've always been calm," Mourinho said in his news conference when asked about the eight game winning run.

"We understand the reasons why we lost [against Atlético] and where we could improve. I will always fight to ensure that in good times, people stay balanced. I always tell them that winning matches in a team like Real Madrid shouldn't lead to crazy joy. Winning matches at Real Madrid has to be normal.

"I see a happy dressing room, with horrible, loud music," he added with a laugh. "When we lose, we enter your chaos, which can then spread to the Madridista environment, to the fans. But in here, we're calm."

The victory also saw Mourinho move onto 97 LaLiga wins in charge of Madrid, three short of becoming only the fourth coach in the club's history to reach the century mark.

Mourinho shuffled his pack from the midweek win at AEK Athens and preferred captain Valverde at right- ack to Trent Alexander-Arnold, who watched from the bench.

And Valverde opened the scoring in the 28th minute with a low strike into the bottom corner. Jude Bellingham set up Turkish attacker Güler, who was starting again in place of the suspended Vinícius Júnior, to double the lead eight minutes later.

A third goal evaded Madrid for large periods of the second half, but Mbappé clinched the points with his 17th goal of the season with 15 minutes left.

Second-from-bottom Valencia ended with 10 men after José Gayà was sent off late on.

Madrid now have to wait two weeks before returning to action at home to Celta Vigo, due to the international break.

Mourinho expressed concern about the condition of his players before heading away with their national teams.

"It worries me, because if the players stayed with me and my staff we would give very special attention to recovering them," he said. "But they go to their national teams.

"I have never coached a national side, but you can imagine that their coaches want to work, and these people can't work now. They need to rest. They need a lot of attention in their recovery."

Information from PA and The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Rob Gronkowski caps Brady-attended Patriots Hall of Fame ceremony with spike
articles.description: Rob Gronkowski was officially inducted into the New England Patriots Hall of Fame on Saturday with fellow Hall of Famers in attendance, including Tom Brady.
articles.headlineJa: ロブ・グロンコウスキー、ブレイディも出席したパトリオッツ殿堂入り式典をトレードマークのスパイクで締めくくる
articles.descriptionJa: 土曜日、ロブ・グロンコウスキーがニューイングランド・パトリオッツの殿堂に正式に登録された。式典にはトム・ブレイディを含む殿堂入りメンバーらが出席した。
articles.body:
FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- With his trademark humor and flair, Rob Gronkowski was officially inducted into the New England Patriots Hall of Fame on Saturday in a ceremony attended by quarterback Tom Brady and capped off with his trademark spike of the football.

"I'm a Patriot for Life. Now let's fiesta!" Gronkowski said as his lighthearted but passionate remarks concluded and he danced before drilling a football into the stage.

That sparked a rousing cheer from the thousands in attendance in the plaza outside Gillette Stadium, as well as Patriots Hall of Famers in attendance, which included Brady, who was the first to share an embrace with Gronkowski on stage after the spike.

Inductees into the Patriots Hall of Fame, who are ultimately selected by a fan vote, are presented red jackets -- similar to the honor of Pro Football Hall of Famers with gold jackets.

 

The sight of Gronkowski and Brady, both donning their red jackets and seated side by side on the stage, was among the highlights of a nostalgic day for New England fans -- made possible by Brady being in town to serve as a Fox analyst for Sunday's game between the visiting Green Bay Packers and Patriots (4:25 p.m. ET).

"Nothing and no one is ever matching what we did over the run we had," said Gronkowski, who donned bright red pants and a white dress shirt with red buttons -- true to his boisterous personality.

Gronkowski played nine seasons in New England, was part of Patriots teams that won nine AFC East championships, appeared in the AFC Championship Game eight times, and made it to the Super Bowl four times.

With New England, he totaled 521 receptions for 7,861 yards and 79 touchdown receptions in the regular season and posted 81 receptions for 1,163 yards and 12 touchdowns in the postseason. He also played two seasons with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

Gronkowski, who grew up in Western New York and now has a full-time residence in Massachusetts, shared how the region made an impact on his life.

"New England will always be home," he said, "and I will always love you guys."

articles.headline: Güler inspires Real Madrid's 8th straight win to go level with Barcelona
articles.description: Arda Güler scored his third goal in five matches to fire Real Madrid to an eighth straight victory and move them level on points with Barcelona with a 3-0 win at Valencia.
articles.headlineJa: ギュレルが牽引しレアル・マドリードが8連勝、バルセロナに追いつく
articles.descriptionJa: アルダ・ギュレルが5試合で3点目となるゴールを決め、レアル・マドリードを8連勝へと導いた。バレンシア戦に3-0で勝利し、勝ち点でバルセロナに並んだ。
articles.body:
Arda Güler scored his third goal in five matches to fire Real Madrid to an eighth straight victory and move them level on points with Barcelona with a 3-0 win at Valencia.

With Vinícius Júnior unavailable due to the final match of his four-game ban, Güler was again chosen by Jose Mourinho and responded with a sweet first-time finish after 36 minutes to put the visitors two goals ahead at Mestalla.

Madrid captain Fede Valverde had opened the scoring in the 28th minute with a low strike into the bottom corner before Jude Bellingham set up Turkish attacker Güler.

A third goal evaded Madrid for large periods of the second half, but Kylian Mbappé clinched the points with a 17th effort of the campaign with 15 minutes left.

Second-from-bottom Valencia ended with 10 men after José Gayà was sent off late on, but Madrid marched on and moved level with Barcelona ahead of their clash with Atlético Madrid on Sunday.

Mourinho shuffled his pack from the midweek win at AEK Athens and preferred captain Valverde at right back to Trent Alexander-Arnold, who watched from the bench.

Alexander-Arnold's former Liverpool teammate Ibrahima Konaté went close early on with a header from a corner before at the other end Thibaut Courtois was forced to deny Aaron Mayol.

Mbappé won a free kick soon after, with Pablo Maffeo penalised with a yellow card for the poor challenge, but worse was to follow for Valencia.

Mbappé curled the set piece into the wall, but Madrid captain Valverde took a touch before he rifled a shot into the bottom corner from 22-yards.

The 28th-minute strike made it back-to-back goals for Valverde after his long-range winner in the Champions League against AEK and eight minutes later Mourinho's men were 2-0 up.

England midfielder Bellingham burst into the area and his deflected cross was fired home by Güler for his fourth goal of the campaign.

Yan Diomande sent an effort wide before halftime, which was followed by a clash between both sets of players.

Valencia head coach Javier Aguirre reacted by introducing Luis Rioja at the break, but Madrid remained dominant, with Stole Dimitrievski called on to thwart Mbappe.

Aguirre made further changes to spark a response from struggling Valencia, but Mbappé made the points safe for Madrid with quarter-of-an-hour left.

Güler, who started in place of the suspended Vinícius, raced on to a ball over the top and passed into Mbappé , who rounded Dimitrievski and slotted into the empty net.

Valencia's night continued to go from bad to worse as José Gayà was sent off with 11 minutes left.

articles.headline: PSG cruise to 11th straight win as Illia Zabarnyi nets winner against Troyes
articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain extended their winning streak to 11 matches in all competitions with a 1-0 victory over Ligue 1 strugglers Troyes at the Parc des Princes.
articles.headlineJa: PSG、イリヤ・ザバルニィの決勝弾で11連勝を飾る
articles.descriptionJa: パリ・サンジェルマンは、パルク・デ・プランスで行われたリーグ・アン下位のトロワ戦に1-0で勝利し、全大会合わせて11連勝を伸ばした。
articles.body:
Paris Saint-Germain extended their winning streak to 11 matches in all competitions with a 1-0 victory over Ligue 1 strugglers Troyes at the Parc des Princes.

Illia Zabarnyi's towering header gave PSG the lead just before half-time.

Despite all of PSG's pressure, Troyes dug in and saw a late goal from Lucas Maronnier ruled out for offside, as Luis Enrique's side were left three points clear at the top of the table above rivals Paris FC.

PSG -- who had thrashed Villarreal 6-0 in the Champions League on Tuesday night -- made a bright start as Senny Mayulu struck the woodwork twice inside the opening six minutes.

Mayulu first saw his shot from the edge of the box deflected on to a post by Troyes goalkeeper Hillel Konaté and then was played clear by Désiré Doué, but his angled effort hit the left upright.

Troyes, who beat fellow strugglers Le Mans last week, sparked into life after 22 minutes when Renaud Ripart's strike from the left side of the area dragged wide.

The hosts were soon back on the offensive as Warren Zaire-Emery's cross was met by a header from Zabarnyi which forced another smart reaction save from Konate.

PSG keeper Matvey Safonov then had to be alert to stop a header from Ripart.

Zabarnyi broke the deadlock six minutes before half-time when he planted a header into the far corner after Mayulu had swung the ball back in from the left.

Ferran Torres went close in first-half stoppage time when his strike was saved by Konate after being played in down the right by Zaire-Emery.

Ripart remained a threat for Troyes and went close again early in the second half when picked out in the box by a pass from Antoine Mille and sent his shot narrowly wide.

Zaire-Emery glanced a header just past the left post from Doue's floated cross in the 59th minute and Torres was denied by another smart stop from Konate before at the other end Ismael Boura's header was stopped by Safonov.

PSG pushed forward again in the closing 20 minutes as Mayulu's 20-yard effort flew just wide.

Troyes thought they had equalised with seven minutes left when Maronnier fired in after Safonov had punched away Idrissa Soukouna's drive following a corner, but the goal was ruled out for offside.

articles.headline: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg surprises mom with new home to fulfill 'lifelong goal'
articles.description: The Golden State Warriors rookie has credited his mother for saving his life with her support and love.
articles.headlineJa: ウォリアーズのヤクセル・レンデボーグ、「生涯の目標」を叶え母親に新居を贈る
articles.descriptionJa: ゴールデンステート・ウォリアーズのルーキーは、母親のサポートと愛が自分の人生を救ってくれたと語った。
articles.body:
In February, Golden State Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg wrote a story for The Players' Tribune titled: "How My Mom Saved My Life." It detailed a conversation Lendeborg had with his mother, Yissel Raposo, during his senior year of high school in 2019 when she proceeded to tell him, "There's no more time to mess around."

Lendeborg needed to take 10 courses at a community college in one year to graduate high school. At first, he was "not having it." But, once he looked at his mother's face, Lendeborg wrote that everything changed for him. His mother "pretty much" saved his life, he said.

Seven years later, Lendeborg thanked his mother by surprising her with a home in California.

He posted a YouTube video on Friday titled: "This one's for Mama Yax." He detailed that the house would help his mom complete the move from New Jersey, where he grew up, to California.

Lendeborg's friends and family gathered in front of house before he handed a box to his mom and said, "Welcome home." His mother appeared teary-eyed as she took the key out of the box, opened the door and the two of them entered the house together. Lendeborg revealed that it took "two to three" months to secure the home and added on X: "Lifelong goal has finally been accomplished. Blessed!"

"There is no gesture big enough to properly say thank you for all the love, sacrifice, and support my mom has poured into me but this moment was pretty special and one I'll never forget," Lendeborg wrote in the video caption. "She deserves it all. For me, it's bigger than basketball. It's about making sure the people who believed in me get to enjoy the blessings too."

Lendeborg has enjoyed early success with the Warriors through nine games. He's averaging 21 points, 7.1 rebounds and 4.1 assists, including a 37-point performance on Nov. 1. But, his journey hasn't always been smooth.

The 24-year-old played three seasons at Arizona Western, a community college in Yuma, before transferring for two more campaigns at UAB. He transferred for the final time as a graduate student in 2025 to Michigan. Lendeborg would average 15.1 points and 6.8 rebounds a game to help lead the Wolverines to the national title.

It made draft night emotional as Lendeborg and his mother shared a moment when the Warriors selected him at No. 11.

"She was saying we did it. All the sacrifice that we made, we finally accomplished it," he said. "You did it. She's proud of me and she's so excited."

Half a year later, she would have a new home.

articles.headline: Enzo Maresca calls for 'balance' after Man City suffer third straight Premier League defeat
articles.description: Enzo Maresca has said he is "concerned" about Manchester City's form after they suffered a third Premier League defeat with a 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: マン City プレミアリーグ3連敗、エンツォ・マレスカ監督が「バランス」を求める
articles.descriptionJa: エンツォ・マレスカ監督は、土曜日のノッティンガム・フォレスト戦に1-3で敗れ、プレミアリーグで3連敗を喫したマンチェスター・シティの状態について「懸念している」と述べた。
articles.body:
Enzo Maresca has called for a balanced reaction about Manchester City's form after they suffered a third Premier League defeat with a 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday.

City won their opening seven games of the season but followed up defeats to Aston Villa and Brighton with a poor performance at the City Ground.

Maresca's side were 2-0 down inside 18 minutes as Jair Cunha and Liam Delap scored before Rayan Cherki's fine strike after the break gave them hope.

But Delap's second on the counter-attack killed the game and left City six points off leaders Arsenal.

"I'm always concerned, even when we win games," Maresca said. "We need to have balance. We won seven in a row. Now we have lost three in a row, so we need balance on that.

"During the international break, try to understand what we can do better, and try to start again after the international break.

"In the same way we have done the first one, we're going to use this international break to try to clarify what we can do better.

"We know we do some things better, and also we know we need to improve things. So we are going to use that and try to understand how we can avoid these kind of games."

Maresca revealed Marc Guéhi and Josko Gvardiol were replaced at half-time due to injury.

"Both injury, both asked for a change," he said. "Marc Guehi an injury. Josko Gvardiol had some issue already during the week, so it was just because they had problems."

The victory could be a coming of age for Delap and Forest, who have struggled to adapt to life under new boss Oliver Glasner, with just one win from their opening nine games.

Delap had scored once in eight games following his club-record move from Chelsea, but his brilliant double proved he can be the man to fire Forest to better things this season.

"It's now for Liam to keep working, getting into his best shape," Glasner said. "Let's say getting back to the Liam Delap he has been at Ipswich, and then even of course improving his game and he has still a lot to improve.

- Nottingham Forest condemn Man City to 3rd straight Premier League loss

- Gianluigi Donnarumma knows he's 'made mistakes' for Man City - Enzo Maresca

- Man City legend David Silva returns from retirement with goal, player of match award

"Definitely not his finishing with left and right, but he has to improve his heading, he has to improve his movements in the box.

"He has to improve his understanding what we're doing out of possession. But, also very honestly, he did very well."

Glasner reacted to Delap's second goal with a touchline sprint to join in the celebrations.

The Austrian said: "Of course, I can't demand from the players they have to outrun the opposition, and I run less than the opposite manager. So I think I had to follow.

"I just was told they were running six or seven kilometres more than City today, and that means I had to run more than Enzo Maresca as well, and I did my job. It was funny for me."

articles.description: Jauan Jennings said he rebuffed the chance to return to the 49ers via trade despite struggling to produce for the Vikings because "I love where I'm at."
articles.headlineJa: バイキングスのWRジョアン・ジェニングス、49ersへの復帰を拒否：「今の環境が気に入っている」
articles.descriptionJa: ジョアン・ジェニングスは、バイキングスでの成績に苦戦しているものの、「今の環境が気に入っている」として、トレードによる49ersへの復帰の機会を拒否したと語った。
articles.body:
EAGAN, Minn. -- Jauan Jennings explained Saturday why he voiced a desire to remain with the Minnesota Vikings earlier this season, despite a steep production decline, as the team discussed a trade that would have returned him to the San Francisco 49ers, where he played the first six seasons of his career.

"I just thought it was best for both teams," Jennings told ESPN. "No distractions. I love where I'm at."

Jennings, who signed a one-year, $8 million contract with the Vikings in June, will miss Monday night's game against the Buffalo Bills because of a strained calf that he suffered in practice this week. He missed a game in Week 2 while grieving the death of a family member, but in six appearances this season he has only 10 targets on 145 routes run. He has caught six of those passes for 54 yards, his lowest totals through eight weeks of a season since he was a part-time player with the 49ers in 2021.

 

Much of that can be explained by the Vikings' intention to maximize targets to receivers Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison, as well as their use of tight end T.J. Hockenson as a safety valve in the middle of the field. The 49ers presumably had more robust plans for Jennings given their injuries this season at the position.

"I'm not the coach, so I don't call the plays," Jennings said. "I'm a player, so I just play the game. I feel like anybody who watches football, who watches sports in general, kind of understands what comes with it."

Jennings was particularly demonstrative on the sideline during a Week 5 victory at the New Orleans Saints, at one point pounding the turf on the sideline after he and quarterback Kyler Murray could not connect on a deep pass. The Vikings had signed veteran receiver Odell Beckham Jr. to their practice squad earlier that week, and they engaged the 49ers in trade talks not long after.

The discussions advanced to the point where Jennings spoke with 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan.

"He likes where he's at," Shanahan said earlier this week, "and I thought he made sense [with] what he said, and I agreed with him."

Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said he has spent "a lot of time talking to [Jennings] throughout the season" and added: "We really built up a strong relationship and out of the respect for the coach to player, that's one thing, but just the respect for our personal relationship that we have, just as we worked through that, I thought really both sides handled things the right way and ultimately I was super fired up that Jauan really enjoys it here, loves being a Minnesota Viking and that's kind of just where we left it."

As of Saturday, the Vikings hadn't yet decided who would replace Jennings as the Vikings' No. 3 receiver on Monday night. Beckham is an option, O'Connell said, but he noted that Beckham has worked in practice mostly as a backup to the positions that Jefferson and Addison play, and only this week got reps at Jennings' "F" position. articles.headline: Saints activate WR Jordyn Tyson, LT Kelvin Banks, cut RB Kendre Miller
articles.description: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. have been activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns.
articles.headlineJa: セインツ、WRジョーダン・タイソンとLTケルビン・バンクスをアクティブ化、RBケンドレ・ミラーを解雇
articles.descriptionJa: セインツのルーキーワイドレシーバー、ジョーダン・タイソンとレフトタックルのケルビン・バンクス・Jr.が、日曜日のブラウンズ戦を前に故障者リストから復帰した。
articles.body:
New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. have been activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.

Tyson, the eighth overall pick in the 2026 draft, is set to make his NFL debut after injuring his hamstring in August. He returned to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.

He has been listed as questionable on the injury report along with Banks, who also returned to practice following surgery on his ankle.

Tyson was expected to be out at least two months after the hamstring injury, which occurred after he landed awkwardly after catching a pass. Both Tyson and the Saints said the injury was not related to his previous hamstring issues from college; he missed three games for Arizona State last year.

He also tore his ACL, MCL and PCL in his left knee when he was at Colorado in 2022, fractured his collarbone in 2024 and sprained his ankle that caused him to miss spring practices in 2025.

Tyson said he feels like the extended time to get himself right has been "a blessing."

"Kind of got a slow start to the NFL, so I got to kind of take my time and kind of really adjust to it," he said.

The Saints released running back Kendre Miller as a corresponding move.

Miller, a 2023 third-round pick out of TCU, led the Saints' struggling run game with 159 yards this season. The Saints released him after claiming running back Audric Estime off waivers from the Cleveland Browns. Estime was with the team last year and in camp but was waived with an injury settlement.

The Saints rushed for only 18 yards in their last game before the bye week, a 16-10 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers in Paris.

articles.headline: Man arrested on stalking charges at LeBron James' home in Los Angeles
articles.description: A man was arrested on Friday night at LeBron James' Brentwood, California, home, a Los Angeles Police Department spokesperson confirmed to ESPN on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: ロサンゼルスのレブロン・ジェームズの自宅でストーキング容疑の男を逮捕
articles.descriptionJa: ロサンゼルス市警察の広報担当者が土曜日にESPNに語ったところによると、金曜日の夜、カリフォルニア州ブレントウッドにあるレブロン・ジェームズの自宅で男が逮捕された。
articles.body:
A man was arrested Friday night at LeBron James' Brentwood, California, home, a Los Angeles Police Department spokesperson confirmed to ESPN on Saturday.

LAPD officers responded to a call at 9:39 p.m. Friday to investigate a possible burglary on James' property, the spokesperson said.

A suspect was apprehended at the residence, taken into custody and booked for stalking, the spokesperson said.

James was in Cleveland on Friday night for his Philadelphia 76ers' game against the Cavaliers. The Sixers lost 119-95 to his former team.

A representative for James had no comment about the incident.

articles.headline: Browns QB Deshaun Watson out of concussion protocol
articles.description: Browns QB Deshaun Watson is out of the concussion protocol, but he is questionable. Shedeur Sanders will get the start against the Saints.
articles.headlineJa: ブラウンズのQBデショーン・ワトソン、脳震盪プロトコルを通過
articles.descriptionJa: ブラウンズのQBデショーン・ワトソンは脳震盪プロトコルを通過しましたが、出場は不透明な状況です。セドゥア・サンダースがセインツ戦の先発を務めます。
articles.body:
Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson has cleared concussion protocol, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

Browns coach Todd Monken said Friday that Shedeur Sanders will get the start. It's unclear if Watson will serve as the backup or if that responsibility will fall to Dillon Gabriel or Taylen Green.

Sanders has attempted just three passes this season in spot appearances during two games. He took all the starting reps in practice this week after Watson self-reported concussion symptoms Tuesday morning and was placed in the protocol.

As a rookie last season, Sanders made seven starts, completing 56.6% of his passes for 1,400 yards with seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions. He went 3-4 in those starts.

Cleveland (5-3) faces the Saints this week and then hosts the Houston Texans in Week 10 before entering their bye.

Information from ESPN's Daniel Oyefusi was used in this report.

articles.body:
ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

What you need to know for Saturday

The NBA goes international today, as the Indiana Pacers and Denver Nuggets face off in Mexico City early this evening.

Indiana guard T.J. McConnell has a chance to make his season debut, while superstar Tyrese Haliburton remains sidelined with a hamstring injury. Denver, meanwhile, is looking to reclaim its identity as a contender.

The stateside portion of the schedule features six other games, headlined by a Western Conference showdown between the expectedly elite San Antonio Spurs and the impressively competitive Portland Trail Blazers. Portland has the statistical makeup (second in offense, 12th in defense) of a real contender. We'll learn about both teams in this marquee matchup.

Among Eastern contenders, the New York Knicks are seeking to go above .500 as they visit a Cleveland Cavaliers group that just dominated a surging Philadelphia 76ers squad last night. With Cleveland possibly missing Jarrett Allen for a second straight game, both Peyton Watson and a veteran forward we'll discuss below could emerge with meaningful roles.

A positive trend across today's slate is the presence of closer point spreads; only one of today's seven games sports a betting line above 7.5 points. This signals potential for competitive contests, which often result in more predictable playing time, usage and production patterns.

With an eye toward uncovering compelling betting angles and fantasy decisions, let's take a look at the day ahead in the NBA.

This second chapter of Hezonja's NBA career has been fascinating. Returning as a physical presence in the paint and on the boards, Hezonja also flashes great footwork on defense and in transition, adding dimension to his impact in real and fantasy contexts. The Cavs might need big minutes from Hezonja on the second leg of a back-to-back with Allen likely out again.

articles.headline: Fantasy basketball: Four players whose upgraded skill sets look real
articles.description: Which players have added new dimensions to their game? Here are four who can sustain their newly-demonstrated skills.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジーバスケ：スキルアップが本物に見える4人の選手
articles.descriptionJa: プレーに新たな次元を加えたのはどの選手か？新しく身につけたスキルを維持できそうな4人を挙げる。
articles.body:
Baseball analyst Ron Shandler famously posited that once a player has demonstrated a skill over a sufficiently meaningful sample, they own it. The key qualifier is that the skill must be demonstrated over a sustained period, not merely in an isolated performance or brief hot streak.

This concept applies to basketball as well. Once a player demonstrates they can effectively protect the rim over multiple months, we can assume they "own" that skill as part of their overall skill set. It was clear early in Walker Kessler's career with the Utah Jazz that he was a special rim protector -- a skill that has proved enduring.

We learn to trust what players can and cannot do on the court over time. Box scores create precedents. Past demonstrated ability deserves more weight than recent struggles because a skill can lie dormant without disappearing.

Which players are establishing new levels of expertise so far this season? Even with the sample size remaining quite small, we can begin to identify new identities around the league. With this lens in mind, let's discuss a quartet of players who have added new dimensions to their real and fantasy reputations thus far.

The prospect who was promised

Incredibly fun and prestigious player comparisons -- to the likes of Rashard Lewis and even Chris Bosh -- surfaced when Jabari Smith Jr. was evaluated during the 2022 NBA draft cycle. While those were lofty comparisons, they spoke to Smith's potential to go beyond a traditional "3-and-D" archetype and develop into a game-changing two-way force.

We're not quite at the All-Star tier for Smith, but it's becoming clear that he is taking ownership of a new level of shooting and scoring. Even though his shot diet this year is identical to last season's, he has leapt nearly 20% in scoring output thanks to appreciable spikes in shooting success. There is danger in simply trusting a hot streak. A more granular look shows Smith is finally thriving off the dribble and as a pull-up shooter, which is also showing up in his ability to initiate and finish drives.

Smith has already proven he owns a unique ability to protect the rim from an atypical position, as his career 2.5% block percentage reveals. The blend of improved shooting and scoring, along with his ability to create turnovers, has Smith positioned 20th overall on the Player Rater, just ahead of Houston Rockets teammate Alperen Sengun. Even when his outside shooting cools -- and it will -- Smith has leveled up enough to remain an impact player.

The ready rookie

Beyond being an amazing soundbite and the oldest prospect in his class, Yaxel Lendeborg was a somewhat mysterious prospect. Dominant rebounding numbers over a long college career did not necessarily indicate a dynamic offensive package.
